The notebooks are ordered according to the workshop flow, progressing from intuition and concepts to computational methods and a practical application example.

## 1. Preliminaries

* GitHub: [preliminaries.ipynb](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/preliminaries.ipynb)
* Colab: [Open in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/preliminaries.ipynb)

Introduces the statistical concepts and variance relations underlying uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis.

---

## 2. G-star benchmark function

* GitHub: [gstar_function.ipynb](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/gstar_function.ipynb)
* Colab: [Open in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/gstar_function.ipynb)

Uses Sobol's G-star function to build intuition for parameter importance, interaction effects, and the interpretation of first-order and total-effect Sobol indices.

---

## 3. Sensitivity concepts

* GitHub: [sensitivity_concepts.ipynb](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/sensitivity_concepts.ipynb)
* Colab: [Open in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/sensitivity_concepts.ipynb)

Develops the concepts underlying variance-based sensitivity analysis through interactive examples and visualizations.

---

## 4. Monte Carlo methods

* GitHub: [monte_carlo.ipynb](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/monte_carlo.ipynb)
* Colab: [Open in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/monte_carlo.ipynb)

Introduces Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation and Saltelli-based estimation of Sobol sensitivity indices.

---

## 5. Polynomial chaos expansions

* GitHub: [introduction_gpc.ipynb](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/introduction_gpc.ipynb)
* Colab: [Open in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/introduction_gpc.ipynb)

Introduces polynomial chaos expansions for uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis, and compares them with Monte Carlo methods.

---

## 6. Arterial wall model example

* GitHub: [wall_models.ipynb](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/wall_models.ipynb)
* Colab: [Open in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/wall_models.ipynb)

Applies Monte Carlo and polynomial chaos methods to arterial wall models and demonstrates uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis in an engineering context.
